say:2:1630430002:1.text: But he immediately kicked me out...
say:2:1630430002:1.source_cn: 但我很快就被主人赶了出来……
say:2:1630430002:1.male: But he immediately kicked me out...
say:2:1630430002:1.female: But he immediately kicked me out...

say:3:1630430003:1.text: He looked so upset. I think he really cares about those rice plants.
say:3:1630430003:1.source_cn: 他看起来很伤心。他很心疼那些稻子。
say:3:1630430003:1.male: He looked so upset. I think he really cares about those rice plants.
say:3:1630430003:1.female: He looked so upset. I think he really cares about those rice plants.

say:4:1630430004:1.text: I didn't know I could crush them. I wanted to say sorry... but he doesn't understand dog.
say:4:1630430004:1.source_cn: 我不知道我会压死那些稻谷的。我很想对主人说一声对不起，...
say:4:1630430004:1.male: I didn't know I could crush them. I wanted to say sorry... but he doesn't understand dog.
